scope: Expose complete ordinary-image create-only recursive FAT extraction through the common command/operation service and actual CLI, protocol, GUI, TUI and interactive shell. Retain the full current 0.1.0 scope. No physical/elevation/customer/install/sign/release or production broker/journal admission.

command.preparation: Observe ordinary source, selected volume/copy, explicit OEM/name/time policy, all destination/ledger/operation-store/code dependencies and finite budgets without output creation. Use an owned reader/preparator; return an immutable review definition plus separate observation/admission facts. Static help/discovery never initializes a provider.
command.execution: Exact review digest plus separate source-read, destination-tree, ledger, operation-store and declared-host grants. Reobserve all actual resources and independently prepare a new owned backend. Compare stable intended effects/resources/namespace against review before any output. Return a durable operation identity for accepted_running; record actual process identity/code/attempt/epoch. Existing filesystem.extract and raw/logical plans retain their meanings.
command.registry_owner: spec/catalog/commands.json#filesystem.tree.extract; no alternate parser/registry in this profile

review_definition.content: An immutable supplied-byte model with a stable projection of the qualified private backend definition: exact selected source/epoch/window/copy, namespace commitment, resource identities/epochs/access/aliases/footprints/verification, canonical locations, metadata policy, budgets and execution generation. Separate explicit operation_store dependency and finite child/evidence footprint. Worker PID, capture ID/sequence and attempt observations belong in receipts, not this effect digest. Preserve the existing process-bound private plan1 unchanged.
review_definition.validation: Strict known mutation-critical fields and bounded decimal integers; no unknown effects/options, source writes, overwrite/delete/force, guessed encoding/timezone, undeclared scratch/recovery resources or grant/acceptance state inside the review definition. A matching imported hash establishes no actor/source/store authentication. Native admission independently compares its owned observations before granting effects.
review_definition.operation_store: Existing ordinary local NTFS directory with exact path/ancestor/directory identity and epoch, explicitly declared finite request/cancel/state children and observation-only reconnect. Grant store effects separately. Bind store/source/code/destination/ledger aliases and dependency ownership before effects; no new incidental state location or automatic cleanup. Selected private review1 control footprint names recursive-request.json, recursive-cancel and recursive-state.ndjson, bounded to 16384 bytes per state record, 1048576 control-history bytes and 64 state records. Original extraction ledger remains a separately declared resource with its own limits.

lifecycle: Prepared reviews do not keep a CLI worker secretly alive. Execution mints a fresh attempt/capture/admission receipt against the same immutable effect definition. Durable operation inspect/wait/watch/cancel reconnect by exact operation/store/code/process identities, observation-only. Active, completed, partial and uncertain states distinguish publication from actual exit and preserve source/code/store/ledger dependencies. No restart/replay/cleanup or new writer from timeout, cancellation or imported history.
interfaces: One descriptor-owned grammar and typed command service shared by CLI/protocol/GUI/TUI/shell. Bind fields/diagnostics/exit outcomes before implementation. Invalid invocations and missing/wrong grants have no provider/output effects as applicable. Bounded pending requests/late observations do not block UI pumps or alter sibling command semantics. Machine output remains noninteractive.
qualification: Independent review-projection/hash/shape/conservation/grant fixtures; stability across real process/capture epochs and sensitivity to every intended resource/policy/effect/namespace/store/code change.

Actual owned prepare/execute/reconnect/cancel/wait/late/hang/exit cases using only generated ordinary images and new trees/stores. Missing/stale/poisoned reviews or grants create no output; source bytes unchanged.
Actual CLI/protocol/GUI/TUI/shell recursive prepare/execution/observation journeys share semantics, source identity and native output/evidence expectations.
Fresh exact-source full native/header/dependency/import/context/manifest/tooling and artifact evidence; old raw/logical/tree commands and limits retain their independent regressions.

native_admission.store: Observe and pin the actual ordinary local NTFS directory/ancestor closure. Require the three reserved control names absent before preparation/admission, reject source/output/code aliases to those names and preserve unrelated/foreign resources. Native file identities and the stable review are compared before effects.
native_admission.claim: After all five exact-review grants and a fresh owned preparation agree, claim recursive-request.json using CREATE_NEW with current-user ACL, then create cancellation/state files without clobbering. The retained request binds review, operation/attempt/worker/code identities and created child identities. Record and flush a dispatch intent before sending the private exact-plan grant. An observed creation or interrupted initialization is retained; no implicit cleanup/retry.
native_admission.bounds: Request header <=524288 bytes; each state record <=16384 bytes; at most64 state records; total request/cancel/state bytes <=1048576 including header and cancel byte. State observation may coalesce progress, reserving space for publication/exit/uncertainty facts. Original extraction metadata ledger remains separate.
native_admission.lifetime: Attach the owned store to the existing worker dependency closure before launch so uncertain retirement retains all source/code/store/ledger dependencies until actual exit. No second scheduler/retention framework. Publication and exit are recorded separately; caller/process/store failures preserve uncertainty.
native_admission.qualification: Actual generated-image/store preparation and execution, independently read control header/hash-chain/IDs and destination bytes, missing/stale/changed/forged grants/reviews, preexisting/racing reserved files, source/store changes, cancellation/late/hang/exit and ownership through retirement. Common reconnect/frontends/full clean-source gates remain.

reconnect.header_versions: Read existing request-prototype/1 as historical evidence. New request-prototype/2 also binds actual controller and writer PID/creation identities; writer/code/attempt/epochs remain independently bound. Header/record consistency or hash equality is not authenticity or current source/destination verification.
reconnect.inspection: Validate bounded canonical header and complete state-record prefixes, sequence/hash/operation/review/process/code/capture/attempt bindings, admissible phase progression and status-dependent outcome counters. Count/hash an incomplete tail separately without admitting it. Reject contradictory complete records including recomputed chains. Preserve declarations independently of current native facts.
reconnect.native_observation: Open only the requested ordinary NTFS store/control artifacts, bind actual directory/ancestor/child identities, host identity and canonical header. Query exact recorded controller/writer process birth and actual executable generation where available. Distinguish matching running/exited handles, absent PID, reused/mismatched identity and unavailable observation. No current source/destination access or new writer.
reconnect.cancellation: Only header2 with intact records/control identity and matching live controller/writer/code can receive a one-byte cancellation request. It is a request, not acknowledgement or exit. The existing owning controller polls its owned cancellation file and forwards stop even if persistence fails. History-only/identity-conflicting/unavailable/torn states do not grant cancellation or restart; completed operation reports too-late conservatively.
reconnect.qualification: Independent header/history/canonical/hash/shape/phase/counter/identity tests, old-version reading, torn/full tampering including rehashed rows, native cross-process inspect/cancel while writer alive, published result before exit, code/process/store/child mismatch and unchanged bytes on refused requests. Detached execution/common wait/watch/frontends/full-source qualification remain.
